+name: MyTodo D4-03 frozen C0-04 isolated regression
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - d4/mobile-integrated-candidate-1
+    paths:
+      - '.github/workflows/d4-03-c0-regression.yml'
+      - 'scripts/ci/c004-android-emulator.mjs'
+      - 'scripts/ci/c004-node-path.*'
+      - 'tests/protocol-harness/**'
+      - 'tests/protocol-vectors/**'
+      - 'tests/credential-harness/**'
+      - '.github/workflows/c0-05-credentials.yml'
+      - 'src/**'
+      - 'windows/**'
+      - 'android/**'
+
+      - 'prototypes/d4-01/**'
+      - 'prototypes/d4-03-platforms/**'
+      - 'tests/d4-ui/**'
+      - 'tests/d4-03-platforms/**'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+env:
+  EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
+
+jobs:
+  desktop:
+    name: Windows C and Node SQLite producer and receiver cases
+    runs-on: windows-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 45
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout exact protocol source
+        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Select a preinstalled Node
+        shell: pwsh
+        run: ./scripts/ci/c004-node-path.ps1
+      - name: Generate and cross-test C and JS samples
+        shell: cmd
+        run: node tests/protocol-harness/run-c004-matrix.mjs --phase desktop --output "%RUNNER_TEMP%\c004-desktop"
+      - name: Preserve desktop matrix artifacts
+        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() }}
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
+        with:
+          name: c004-desktop-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/c004-desktop/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          include-hidden-files: true
+          retention-days: 14
+
+  android:
+    name: Android SQLite shard ${{ matrix.shard }}
+    needs: desktop
+    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 50
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      max-parallel: 8
+      matrix:
+        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]
+    env:
+      MYTODO_ANDROID_IMAGE_INSTALL: '1'
+      MYTODO_ANDROID_PULSE_INSTALL: '1'
+      MYTODO_ANDROID_IMAGE_REVISION: ${{ vars.MYTODO_ANDROID_IMAGE_REVISION }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout exact protocol source
+        id: checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Select a preinstalled Node
+        id: node
+        run: bash scripts/ci/c004-node-path.sh
+      - name: Inspect and start the Android test emulator
+        id: emulator
+        run: node scripts/ci/c004-android-emulator.mjs start
+      - name: Load the desktop artifacts from this workflow attempt
+        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && steps.checkout.outcome == 'success' && steps.node.outcome == 'success' }}
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
+        with:
+          name: c004-desktop-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/c004-desktop-input/
+      - name: Run Android generation and cross-platform reception
+        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && steps.checkout.outcome == 'success' && steps.node.outcome == 'success' }}
+        run: >-
+          node tests/protocol-harness/run-c004-matrix.mjs --phase android --android-shard ${{ matrix.shard }}
+          --desktop "$RUNNER_TEMP/c004-desktop-input"
+          --android-environment "$RUNNER_TEMP/c004-android-emulator/environment.json"
+          --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/c004-android"
+      - name: Stop the Android emulator and finish the environment evidence
+        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && steps.emulator.outcome != 'skipped' }}
+        run: node scripts/ci/c004-android-emulator.mjs finish
+      - name: Preserve raw emulator environment evidence
+        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() }}
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
+        with:
+          name: c004-android-environment-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/c004-android-emulator/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 14
+      - name: Preserve Android APK, SQLite exports and matrix artifacts
+        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() }}
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
+        with:
+          name: c004-android-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/c004-android/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          include-hidden-files: true
+          retention-days: 14
+
+  complete:
+    name: Android to Windows and Node reception and matrix comparison
+    needs: [desktop, android]
+    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() }}
+    runs-on: windows-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 45
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout exact protocol source
+        id: checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Select a preinstalled Node
+        id: node
+        shell: pwsh
+        run: ./scripts/ci/c004-node-path.ps1
+      - name: Load the desktop artifacts from this workflow attempt
+        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && steps.checkout.outcome == 'success' && steps.node.outcome == 'success' }}
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
+        with:
+          name: c004-desktop-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/c004-desktop-input/
+      - name: Load the Android artifacts from this workflow attempt
+        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && steps.checkout.outcome == 'success' && steps.node.outcome == 'success' }}
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
+        with:
+          pattern: c004-android-shard-*-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/c004-android-input/
+      - name: Verify producer lineage and complete the three-platform matrix
+        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && steps.checkout.outcome == 'success' && steps.node.outcome == 'success' }}
+        shell: cmd
+        run: >-
+          node tests/protocol-harness/run-c004-matrix.mjs --phase complete
+          --desktop "%RUNNER_TEMP%\c004-desktop-input"
+          --android "%RUNNER_TEMP%\c004-android-input"
+          --output "%RUNNER_TEMP%\c004-complete"
+      - name: Preserve final comparisons and failure evidence
+        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() }}
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
+        with:
+          name: c004-complete-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/c004-complete/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          include-hidden-files: true
+          retention-days: 14

+    env:
+      EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}

+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: '24'

+# D4-01 / D4-02 并行产品候选
+
+2026-11-25 Asia/Shanghai。B 线从 master 建独立 d4/ui-candidate-1；不引入 D2 候选生产迁移。
+
+## 可体验范围
+
+PROPOSAL：11 页统一导航、四象限颜色和详情抽屉，Windows 直接打开单文件 HTML；Android/Web 使用相同响应式原型。完成界面确认后才进入原生 D4-05 接入。
+
+FACT（源码）：任务结构沿用冻结 master 的 V2 模型，done、start/end 北京时间字符串、project 名称、嵌套 subtasks；复用 model、schedule、task-tree、task-editor、personal-ui 与 sync-core 的纯内存函数。未加载生产 storage、sync-client、accounts、replica，也不启动任何 Actor/outbox 或网络服务。
+
+FACT（候选实现）：独立 repository 使用 mytodo-d4-01-demo-v1，内容带 synthetic kind 标记。项目 ID、工作事项关联、归档任务和工作模块放在独立 demo 扩展。composite 仅供原型展现，写回时 core 由成熟 normalizeState 校验，扩展独立保存。循环生成任务和子任务的演示关系单独物化，禁止写入生产字段。
+
+## 行为与核验
+
+PROPOSAL：工作台、任务 CRUD、子任务、循环、提醒中心、搜索过滤、项目及事项 CRUD/关联、模板/实例运行、往来跟进、归档恢复、统计、设置偏好和合成导出。提醒仅显示应用内计划；无原生后台通知能力声明。
+

+# GitHub metadata/archive file processing only. No project tests or SQLite opens.
+import hashlib,json,pathlib,re,subprocess,sys,zipfile,io
+repository='johny751/MyTodo'
+root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();kind=sys.argv[2];runs=json.loads(sys.argv[3])
+if kind not in ('d4','d4-font','a'):raise RuntimeError('Unknown evidence domain')
+is_ui=kind.startswith('d4')
+directory=root/('docs/upgrade/d4-01/evidence-font' if kind=='d4-font' else 'docs/upgrade/d4-01/evidence' if is_ui else 'docs/a-admission/evidence')
+directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True) # Allows a predeclared .gitattributes; write() still refuses every overwrite.
+def api(endpoint,binary=False):
+    data=subprocess.check_output(['gh','api','repos/'+repository+'/'+endpoint])
+    return data if binary else json.loads(data)
+def write(name,data):
+    file=directory/name;file.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+    if file.exists():raise RuntimeError('Evidence overwrite refused: '+name)
+    file.write_bytes(data if isinstance(data,bytes) else (json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
+    return {'path':str(file.relative_to(root)),'bytes':file.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
+manifest=[];summary=[]
+for run in runs:
+    runid=str(run['id']);meta=api('actions/runs/'+runid)
+    if meta['head_sha']!=run['sha'] or meta['head_branch']!=('d4/ui-candidate-1' if is_ui else 'a/admission-candidate-1') or meta['status']!='completed':raise RuntimeError('Run/source/branch/completion mismatch')
+    attempt=meta['run_attempt'];prefix='run-'+runid+'-attempt-'+str(attempt)
+    manifest.append(write(prefix+'/run.json',meta))
+    jobs=api('actions/runs/'+runid+'/attempts/'+str(attempt)+'/jobs?per_page=100');manifest.append(write(prefix+'/jobs.json',jobs))
+    logs=api('actions/runs/'+runid+'/attempts/'+str(attempt)+'/logs',True);manifest.append(write(prefix+'/official-logs.zip',logs))
+    artifacts=api('actions/runs/'+runid+'/artifacts?per_page=100');manifest.append(write(prefix+'/artifacts.json',artifacts))
+    for artifact in artifacts['artifacts']:
+        if artifact.get('expired'):raise RuntimeError('Expired artifact '+artifact['name'])
+        name=str(artifact['id'])+'-'+re.sub('[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]','_',artifact['name'])
+        raw=api('actions/artifacts/'+str(artifact['id'])+'/zip',True)
+        digest='sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+        if artifact.get('digest')!=digest:raise RuntimeError('Official artifact digest mismatch: '+name)
+        manifest.append(write(prefix+'/'+name+'.zip',raw))
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as z:
+            if sum(x.file_size for x in z.infolist())>100_000_000:raise RuntimeError('Artifact expansion limit')
+            for item in z.infolist():
+                p=pathlib.PurePosixPath(item.filename)
+                if p.is_absolute() or '..' in p.parts or '\\' in item.filename or (item.external_attr>>16)&0o170000==0o120000:raise RuntimeError('Unsafe artifact member')
+                if item.is_dir():continue
+                manifest.append(write(prefix+'/extracted/'+name+'/'+str(p),z.read(item)))
+    summary.append({'runId':runid,'attempt':attempt,'sourceSHA':meta['head_sha'],'conclusion':meta['conclusion'],'url':meta['html_url'],'artifacts':artifacts['total_count'],'jobs':[{'name':j['name'],'conclusion':j['conclusion']} for j in jobs['jobs']]})
+write('sha256-manifest.json',{'kind':kind,'files':manifest,'runs':summary})
+write('run-summary.json',summary)
+archive=root/('docs/upgrade/d4-01/d4-font-receipt-export.zip' if kind=='d4-font' else 'docs/upgrade/d4-01/d4-receipt-export.zip' if is_ui else 'docs/a-admission/a-receipt-export.zip')
+with zipfile.ZipFile(archive,'x',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
+    for file in sorted(directory.rglob('*')):
+        if file.is_file():z.write(file,str(file.relative_to(directory)))
+print(json.dumps({'status':'collected','kind':kind,'files':len(manifest),'export':str(archive.relative_to(root)),'exportSHA256':hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'exportBytes':archive.stat().st_size,'runs':summary},indent=2))

+# MyTodo D4 可操作体验版
+
+双击 mytodo-d4-01-demo.html，或运行 open-mytodo-demo.bat。无需安装、无需联网。
+
+11 个页面可通过左侧导航访问；手机尺寸使用左上角菜单。任务、子任务、项目、事项、流程、往来、归档和统计操作使用合成数据。提醒显示于应用内提醒中心。
+
+保存仅使用 mytodo-d4-01-demo-v1 专用演示空间；浏览器限制 file:// 保存时退回当前会话内存。设置页可导出合成修改或重置示例。
+

+# File/hash/Git publisher only. Never executes application/build/test/SQLite code.
+import hashlib,json,pathlib,re,subprocess,sys,zipfile
+root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
+manifest_path=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
+manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+def git(*args):
+    return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root),*args],text=True).strip()
+branch=manifest['branch'];base=manifest['base']
+if git('branch','--show-current')!=branch: raise RuntimeError('Wrong candidate branch')
+if git('status','--porcelain'): raise RuntimeError('Preserve existing changes; publisher requires clean worktree')
+git('merge-base','--is-ancestor',base,'HEAD')
+archive=manifest_path.parent/manifest['archive']
+if hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=manifest['sha256']: raise RuntimeError('Source archive SHA mismatch')
+pattern=re.compile(manifest['allowed'])
+expected={x['path']:x for x in manifest['files']}
+with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
+    if len(z.infolist())!=len(expected) or len({x.filename for x in z.infolist()})!=len(expected): raise RuntimeError('Duplicate/count archive failure')
+    for item in z.infolist():
+        name=item.filename
+        if name not in expected or not pattern.fullmatch(name) or '\\' in name or '..' in pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).parts or name.startswith('/'): raise RuntimeError('Unauthorized file '+name)
+        if item.file_size>2_000_000: raise RuntimeError('Oversized source')
+        data=z.read(item)
+        if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=expected[name]['sha256'] or len(data)!=expected[name]['bytes']: raise RuntimeError('Source bytes mismatch '+name)
+        target=root/name
+        if target.is_symlink() or any(p.is_symlink() for p in target.parents if p!=root and root in p.parents): raise RuntimeError('Linked target')
+        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+        target.write_bytes(data)
+git('diff','--check')
+changed=git('status','--porcelain').splitlines()
+git('add','--',*sorted(expected))
+staged=git('diff','--cached','--name-only').splitlines()

+
+2026-11-25 (Asia/Shanghai). This document describes source facts. Execution and browser acceptance remain UNVERIFIED until the matching Actions receipts exist.
+
+FACT (source): `prototypes/d4-01/domain.mjs` imports actual frozen baseline modules. No production `src` file is edited. It does not import production storage, account/replica/native bindings, reminder startup or sync-client. The prototype holds normalized V2 state and isolated mock extensions in memory, and optionally serializes them only under `mytodo-d4-01-demo-v1`.
+
+The actual reuse graph is:
+
+| Frozen module | Actual functions used |
+| --- | --- |
+| `src/task-tree.mjs` | `findTaskEntry`, `findTask`, `flattenTasks`, `moveSubtask`; descendants remain in their containing arrays |
+| `src/schedule.mjs` | `setTaskDone`, `nextOccurrence`, `reminderTime`, `taskStats`, schedule labels and Shanghai time parsing/formatting |
+| `src/model.mjs` | `normalizeState`, `seedState`, `visibleTasks`, `searchAll`, `matchesQuery`, `moveTask`, ID validation and date helpers |
+| `src/task-editor.mjs` | `saveTaskRecord` for both roots and nested saves; `quickSubtask` for inherited quick-child defaults and limits |
+| `src/personal-ui.mjs` | `validateSchedule`; its UI render functions are not invoked |
+| `src/sync-core.mjs` | Pure transitive dependency required by the unchanged task-editor module; the facade always passes `base=null`, so it does not invoke merge/sync exchange |
+
+FACT (source): normalization, search, tree iteration, repeat calculation, descendant rekeying/reset/time shifting, reminder calculation and order calculation are not reimplemented. The facade adds transaction boundaries, generated synthetic IDs, cloned snapshots, isolated persistence and listener notifications. Creating/editing a task uses actual `saveTaskRecord`; completing a task, including a changed `done` field in `updateTask`, uses actual `setTaskDone`. Deletion splices the actual `findTaskEntry` containing array, matching the mature app's orchestration. Failed mutations never replace the accepted in-memory state.
+
+FACT (source): core fields remain mature V2, including Boolean `done`, local Shanghai `start`/`end`, project **name**, nested `subtasks`, repeat rules and reminder rules. The prototype does not add `status` or `projectId` to core tasks. Work-module `projectId`, participants, meetings and similar discussion-only extensions live in `demo`; the normalizer is not bypassed. Existing group/project behavior keeps name-based associations.
+
+## Facade API
+
+Classic output exposes `globalThis.DemoDomain`. The ESM source exports the same named interface for Actions tests.
+
+```javascript
+const repo = DemoDomain.createRepository({
+  state: coreV2Seed,
+  demo: mockWorkSeed,
+  storage: null, // explicit memory; omit to try the dedicated browser key
+  clock: () => '2026-11-25T04:00:00.000Z',
+  idFactory: () => 'caller-supplied-unique-synthetic-id'
+});
+```
+
+`clock` returns an ISO instant. Defaults use the actual current instant; mature `dayKey` determines the Shanghai day. A supplied seed controls the discussion factory date. Neither clock nor storage is used to invent production build/version history.
+
+| Interface | Result / behavior |
+| --- | --- |
+| `state`, `getState()` | Cloned normalized V2 snapshot |
+| `demo`, `getDemo()` | Cloned independent mock snapshot |
+| `createTask(fields,parentId=null)` | Saved normalized task; nested creation inherits mature parent defaults |
+| `addSubtask(parentId,fieldsOrTitle)` | Saved child; a string calls actual `quickSubtask` |
+| `getTask(id)`, `updateTask(id,patch)`, `deleteTask(id)` | Cloned task/null, saved task, removed subtree respectively |
+| `setTaskDone(id,done=true)` | Saved task; mature repeat generation occurs once and capacity errors keep old state |
+| `listTasks(options)` | Mature filtered roots; `includeSubtasks:true` expands the tree; default pending status |
+| `search(query)` | Mature `searchAll` tasks/notes/projects/tags/places with nested content and NFKC AND terms |
+| `moveTask`, `moveSubtask` | Actual root/sibling manual order operations |
+| `reminderAt(id)`, `nextOccurrence(id)`, `stats(at?)` | Mature calculation results; no OS/browser reminder scheduling |
+| `transaction(mutatorCore)` | Apply a synchronous mutation to a cloned core, then normalize and commit atomically |
+| `batch(fn)` | Synchronous workspace operation; nested core/mock edits defer to one combined persistence write and one `batch` event; any failure restores both snapshots |
+| `replaceState(next,{preserveDemo:true})` | Replace normalized core; keep independent mock state by default |
+| `updateDemo(patchOrMutator)` | Apply a shallow patch or synchronous mutation to independent JSON mock state |
+| `reset(next?)`, `subscribe(listener)` | Reset to seed/explicit V2; subscribe to cloned core plus event/mock snapshots |
+| `persistence()` | Dedicated key, localStorage/memory mode, load status and actual storage error |
+
+`DemoDomain.QUADRANTS` and `DemoDomain.helpers` expose direct mature references for display and calculations. Full snapshots are read-only by convention because getters clone them; writes use the facade. Use `batch` whenever a UI operation changes both core and mock metadata: one stored envelope and one notification describe the final combined state. Nested batches share the outer rollback; even a caught nested failure rejects the outer operation. Async callbacks/Promise results are refused. Invalid/foreign/corrupt persisted data is preserved and the repository falls back to an independent memory seed. A quota/security failure after an accepted batch preserves the complete current workspace in memory. No production key is read or overwritten.

+## Single-file offline build
+
+FACT (source): `tests/d4-ui/build-demo.mjs` reads only the approved pure graph and `index.html`, `styles.css`, `work-pages.js`, `app.js`. It transforms only known named ESM imports/exports into isolated classic namespaces, checks dependencies and cycles, and syntax-compiles the complete classic bundle with Node's built-in VM. It does not execute browser UI code and needs no npm packages.

+Known script/stylesheet references are replaced by inline CSS and a single classic script in graph → `DemoDomain` → work pages → app order. Unknown script/stylesheet/media dependencies, external CSS imports, unbundled CSS assets and residual ESM are refused. Replacement callbacks preserve literal `$` patterns in source. The result requires no local HTTP server or module fetch, so Windows `file://` can load its resources. Actual browser interaction and file-origin persistence still need UI acceptance; file-origin storage restrictions are handled by the facade's memory fallback.

+## 根模块接口
+
+```js
+window.DemoWorkPages = {
+  render(route, ctx),                // HTML；不负责根事件监听
+  act(action, id, ctx),              // true 表示已处理
+  submit(formName, values, ctx),     // true 表示已处理，values 支持 FormData / plain object
+  seed(today)                       // 独立 synthetic Demo 种子
+};
+```
+
+根路由中的 `projects / work-items / templates / processes / contacts / archive / analytics` 调用此模块。按钮使用 `data-action="work-…"` 与 `data-id`；根通过事件委托调用 `act`。表单使用 `data-form`，值原样传给 `submit`：
+
+| 表单名 | 用途 |
+|---|---|
+| `work-project` | 新建 / 编辑项目 |
+| `work-work-item` | 新建 / 编辑工作事项 |
+| `work-template` | 模板名称、说明和逐行步骤编辑 |
+| `work-process` | 从模板创建 / 编辑实例名称与项目 |
+| `work-contact` | 联系人编辑 |
+| `work-followup` | 联系人的跟进事项编辑 |
+| `work-link-project` / `work-link-work` | 关联已有任务 |
+| `work-filter` | 当前页面的搜索、状态、项目 / 归档类型筛选 |
+
+`submit` 也接受 `project/workitem/template/process/contact/followup` 别名。只有 UI 字段，不构成生产存储合同。
+
+`ctx` 的必要成员：`state`（可编辑 composite projection）或 `getState()`（优先，实时取得新 projection）、`transaction(mutator)`、`esc(value)`、`toast(message)`、`navigate(route)`、`openTask(id)`、`modal(html)`、`closeModal()`。可选 `today`（上海日期字符串）与 `view.query`（根全局搜索）。`transaction` 应原子提交 synthetic projection 并触发根重渲染；异常不提交，返回 `false` 不视为成功，也可返回 Promise。关联 / 跟进提交后再次打开详情，故上下文应提供实时 getter，或保持 `state` 视图及时更新。
+
+页面内筛选为闭包中各 route 的临时视图；不写入生产数据。搜索按 NFKC、多关键词同时匹配，根全局搜索与页面内搜索同时生效。清除页面筛选不会改变根全局搜索。
+
+## Demo 数据结构
+
+根仓库继续保留标准 V2：任务使用 `done/start/end/project(string)/subtasks`；项目使用 `id/name/description/archived`。根将 Demo 专有关系映射为 taskLinks、archives、projectMeta，向此模块提供 composite，提交时分拆回 core 与 demo。任务在 composite 中可含 `projectId/workItemId/archived`，仅为 Demo 映射；统计仍优先使用 `done` 与 `start`，嵌套 / flat 子任务按 ID 去重。
+
+| Demo projection | 当前字段与职责 |
+|---|---|
+| projects + projectMeta | status：active/paused/completed，color：q0–q3，dueDate；标准项目字段仍由 core 管理 |
+| workItems | id/title/projectId/status(planned/doing/waiting/done)/owner/description/dueDate/archived |
+| templates | id/name/description/steps[{id,title,description}]/archived |
+| processes | id/name/templateId/projectId/status(running/paused/completed)/currentStep/steps[{id,title,description,completed,completedAt}]/archived |
+| contacts | id/name/organization/role/email/phone/notes/followups[{id,title,dueDate,status(pending/done),notes,completedAt}]/archived |
+
+种子仅返回 projectMeta 与四组 demo 数组。三个 core 项目由根提供，ID 固定为 `project-delivery / project-product / project-operations`。所有示例联系人、工作与流程均为合成数据，不填写真实联系方式，不访问原应用账户和存储空间。
+
+## 页面行为
+
+| 页面 | 可操作行为 |
+|---|---|
+| 项目 | 新建、编辑、删除、归档；搜索 / 状态筛选；查看任务并打开详情；关联 / 解除已有任务；项目改名更新 task.project；任务进度按当前实际状态计算 |
+| 工作事项 | 新建、编辑、删除、归档；项目 / 状态 / 搜索筛选；关联任务；更换事项项目同步其已关联任务的项目；事项状态单独管理，不自动替代任务完成状态 |
+| 流程模板 | 新建、编辑、删除、归档；每行一步可增加、删除、调整顺序，1–20 步；由模板创建实例，复制步骤内容，后续模板编辑不改已有实例 |
+| 流程实例 | 从模板创建；编辑名称 / 项目；完成当前步，最后一步完成后流程结束；暂停 / 继续；暂停时推进按钮 disabled，事件层也拒绝推进；归档、删除 |

+"""Codespaces evidence reads only. Never builds, tests, opens a DB or edits Git."""
+import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
+
+repo='johny751/MyTodo'
+root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
+assert str(root).startswith('/workspaces/d403-evidence-') and not root.exists()
+root.mkdir()
+def api(endpoint):
+    return subprocess.check_output(['gh','api',endpoint],text=True)
+def save(name,contents):
+    target=root/name;target.write_text(contents,encoding='utf-8')
+    return json.loads(contents)
+records=[]
+for run_id in ('45533988173','45533988196'):
+    run=save('run-'+run_id+'.json',api('repos/'+repo+'/actions/runs/'+run_id))
+    jobs=save('jobs-'+run_id+'.json',api('repos/'+repo+'/actions/runs/'+run_id+'/jobs?per_page=100'))
+    artifacts=save('artifacts-'+run_id+'.json',api('repos/'+repo+'/actions/runs/'+run_id+'/artifacts?per_page=100'))
+    annotations=[]
+    for job in jobs['jobs']:
+        check_id=job['check_run_url'].rsplit('/',1)[1]
+        items=save('annotations-'+run_id+'-'+str(job['id'])+'.json',api('repos/'+repo+'/check-runs/'+check_id+'/annotations?per_page=100'))
+        annotations.extend(items)
+    messages=[item.get('message','') for item in annotations]
+    blocked=any('recent account payments have failed or your spending limit needs to be increased' in message for message in messages)
+    assert run['head_sha']=='288b0b97d9974e3797a5099c97d5aeb1c3e26dc9'
+    assert blocked and artifacts['total_count']==0
+    logs=subprocess.run(['gh','run','view',run_id,'-R',repo,'--log-failed'],capture_output=True,text=True)
+    (root/('log-failed-'+run_id+'.txt')).write_text(logs.stdout,encoding='utf-8')
+    (root/('log-failed-'+run_id+'-stderr.txt')).write_text(logs.stderr,encoding='utf-8')
+    records.append({'runId':run_id,'runAttempt':run['run_attempt'],'sourceSHA':run['head_sha'],
+        'url':run['html_url'],'status':run['status'],'conclusion':run['conclusion'],
+        'executionStatus':'BLOCKER — GitHub refused runner start because of billing/spending limit',
+        'testExecuted':0,'testPassed':0,'testFailed':0,'artifactCount':0,
+        'failedJobCount':sum(job['conclusion']=='failure' for job in jobs['jobs']),
+        'skippedJobCount':sum(job['conclusion']=='skipped' for job in jobs['jobs']),
+        'annotationMessages':sorted(set(messages)),
+        'rawFailedLogExitCode':logs.returncode,
+        'logNote':'No execution log exists for jobs rejected before runner start; original annotations are the failure evidence.'})
+save('execution-blocker.json',json.dumps({'kind':'D4-03 blocked Actions evidence','runs':records,
+    'stageStatus':'NOT CLOSED; candidate implementation is unverified',
+    'nextStep':'Owner restores GitHub Actions availability; rerun the exact candidate workflows in hosted Actions.',
+    'localBuildOrTestFallback':False,'productionDataAccess':False,'productionSyncChanged':False},indent=2)+'\n')
+files=[]
+for file in sorted(root.iterdir()):
+    if file.is_file():
+        data=file.read_bytes();files.append({'path':file.name,'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
+(root/'sha256-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'files':files},indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
+print(json.dumps({'directory':str(root),'files':len(files),'runs':records},indent=2))

+## 5. 关系与字段兼容结论
+
+1. **FACT：原任务的 project 是名称，项目实体同时有独立 id。** app.mjs:127 用 task.project===p.name 计算项目任务；147 使用名字判重；159 删除项目时按名字清空任务关联。Windows detail.c:13 以名称查询现存分类，给 project 新建 UUID，task.project 保持名称。D4 不得把“历史数据已经按ID关联”写成事实。
+2. **PROPOSAL：新工作关系只在 isolated taskLinks/view-model 中使用 projectId/workItemId。** D4-01 app.js:21–34、75 已提供旁路示例。历史名字映射只有唯一匹配才可建议候选；零匹配、重名多匹配、已删除/已归档状态应保持 unresolved，并要求明确选择。任何生产关联改写或数据库迁移是 BLOCKER/另案权限，不能本轮自动执行。

+# D4-03 工作管理模块整合记录
+
+状态：**候选代码已编写；本机未运行编译或测试，等待 GitHub Actions**。

+本记录仅覆盖 `prototypes/d4-01/work-pages.js`、`tests/d4-ui/work-cases.mjs`。不是 D4-03 全阶段完成报告，也不代表 Windows / Android 原生回归通过。
+
+## 边界与证据分类
+
+- **FACT（静态代码证据）**：工作页面沿用 `DemoWorkPages.render/act/submit/seed`；通过主界面的 `ctx.transaction` 修改独立合成 composite。V2 的 `tasks/projects/notes/tags/places` 继续由既有纯业务模块规范化；工作扩展和关系字段保存在 `repo.demo`。
+- **FACT（静态代码证据）**：没有新增网络请求、同步启动、真实数据库入口、生产 SQLite 结构或迁移。没有修改 ACK / outbox / cursor / manifest / batch。没有引用 D2 候选迁移。
+- **PROPOSAL**：下列新增字段是本阶段隔离体验的候选视图模型，不是批准的生产数据契约，也不是已经迁移的生产字段。
+- **UNVERIFIED**：所有新增浏览器断言等待 Actions；Android 触屏、后台、原生存储、Windows Win32 回归与真实数据关系兼容由主阶段报告分别记录。

+## 候选字段与实际交互
+

+|---|---|---|
+| 项目 | `projectMeta[id].owner/members/status/color/dueDate/history` | 创建、编辑、负责人、成员去重、任务 / 事项 / 实例关联展示、进度、归档和删除。扩展不进入 V2 项目记录。 |
+| 工作事项 | `owner/plannedStart/dueDate/priority/projectId/processId/notes/attachments/history/completedAt` | 新建 / 编辑、日期校验、状态、关联任务 / 项目 / 实例、原始备注、附件、历史、归档；事项状态与任务完成分别管理。 |
+| 模板 | `version/enabled/copiedFrom/history` | 新建、编辑步骤、版本递增、复制、停用 / 启用、归档、删除规则。相同定义再次保存不递增版本。复制生成新 ID、步骤 ID 和独立 v1。 |
+| 实例 | `templateVersion/templateSnapshot/sourceStepId/history` | 创建时深复制模板定义；步骤按序运行、暂停、继续、完成、历史、归档。后续模板变更、停用、删除不能改变快照或运行步骤。 |
+| 往来跟进 | `occurredOn/dueDate/projectId/workItemId/notes/history` | 记录沟通日期、下次跟进、关联项目 / 事项、完成 / 重新跟进、编辑和删除。删除单条跟进时在联系人历史保留操作前记录。 |

+
+**FACT（静态代码证据）**：描述、事项备注和沟通文本使用原字符串，保存时不统一 trim。标题与候选成员输入继续做 UI 校验。所有历史 `at` 是实际操作时的 ISO 时刻；未记录的历史日期不补造。
+
+## 名称、ID 与删除
+
+**FACT（静态代码证据）**：V2 任务继续保留 `project` 名称字段；候选关联使用独立 `projectId`。名称回退只适用于该名称在项目集合中唯一的情况。重名项目选择项显示 ID；编辑已存在的重名项目可保持原名称，不能因修改负责人而被强制改名。

+
+**BLOCKER**：实际历史任务只有名称、且存在多个同名项目时，不能在生产环境自动建立 ID 关系；需真实数据只读预检授权和负责人映射策略。隔离体验不绕过这一限制。
+
+## 模板版本与历史缺口
+
+**FACT（静态代码证据）**：新建模板起始 v1，改变名称、说明或步骤后递增；模板启用状态独立于定义版本。实例拥有独立定义快照、运行步骤和操作历史，不从当前模板动态读取步骤。

+
+**BLOCKER**：真实历史实例快照、模板版本关系及平台存储入口尚需各端正式接入证据，本浏览器候选不能代替生产历史验证。
+
+## 原始附件契约
+
+**FACT（静态代码证据）**：事项附件由用户明确选择隔离体验文件，读取 `arrayBuffer()`；保存原字节 base64、字节数、SHA-256、文件名、MIME、lastModified 和实际捕获时刻。不压缩、不转码、不读取任何用户数据库、不上传远端。
+
+下载前重新解码并验证长度和 SHA-256；不匹配则拒绝生成下载 Blob。下载使用二进制类型，原字节不变。删除附件需明确点击确认，历史保留文件元数据和哈希；历史不会重复复制大段 base64。

+
+## 统计日期口径
+
+个人任务按开始日期筛选；事项按计划开始，缺失时截止 / 创建日期；项目按截止，缺失时创建日期；实例按创建日期；往来按沟通，缺失时创建日期。归档按归档日期筛选。时间段筛选时缺少有效日期的条目排除，并明确说明不补造日期。含 Z 或时区偏移的时刻转换为 Asia/Shanghai 日期；日期及无偏移的业务本地时间保留原日期，避免随云端宿主时区改变。任务完成趋势仅按已记录完成日期统计，包含跨北京时间午夜的合成边界用例。

+**PROPOSAL**：这些筛选口径用于本候选页面讨论。正式生产分析口径仍需各端统一接入和负责人验收，不能替换原有个人统计实现。

+demo="${1:?verified single HTML path required}"

+node prototypes/d4-03-platforms/prepare.mjs "$demo" "$out"

+[[ -d "$sdk/platforms" && -d "$sdk/build-tools" ]] || { echo 'Runner Android SDK missing; no dependency download fallback' >&2; exit 1; }
+api="${D4_ANDROID_API:-35}"
+android_jar="$sdk/platforms/android-$api/android.jar"
+[[ -f "$android_jar" ]] || { echo "Runner android-$api/android.jar missing; configure official SDK in workflow" >&2; exit 1; }
+tools_version="${D4_ANDROID_BUILD_TOOLS:-}"
+if [[ -z "$tools_version" ]]; then tools_version="$(find "$sdk/build-tools" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -printf '%f\n' | sort -V | tail -1)"; fi
+bt="$sdk/build-tools/$tools_version"
+for tool in aapt2 d8 zipalign apksigner; do [[ -x "$bt/$tool" ]] || { echo "Missing runner tool $tool" >&2; exit 1; }; done
+mkdir -p "$out/classes" "$out/dex"
+"$bt/aapt2" compile --dir prototypes/d4-03-platforms/android/res -o "$out/resources.zip"
+"$bt/aapt2" link -I "$android_jar" --manifest "$out/AndroidManifest.xml" -A "$out/assets" -o "$out/unsigned.apk" "$out/resources.zip"
+find prototypes/d4-03-platforms/android/src "$out/generated" -name '*.java' -print > "$out/java-sources.txt"
+javac -encoding UTF-8 -source 8 -target 8 -classpath "$android_jar" -d "$out/classes" @"$out/java-sources.txt"
+jar cf "$out/classes.jar" -C "$out/classes" .
+"$bt/d8" --lib "$android_jar" --min-api 26 --output "$out/dex" "$out/classes.jar"
+(cd "$out/dex"; zip -q "$out/unsigned.apk" classes*.dex)
+"$bt/zipalign" -p 4 "$out/unsigned.apk" "$out/aligned.apk"
+# Ephemeral key is confined to this independent preview. No production signing key.
+keytool -genkeypair -keystore "$out/isolated-test-key.jks" -storepass android -keypass android -alias d403preview \
+ -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 30 -dname "CN=MyTodo D4-03 Isolated CI"
+"$bt/apksigner" sign --ks "$out/isolated-test-key.jks" --ks-pass pass:android --key-pass pass:android --ks-key-alias d403preview \
+ --out "$out/mytodo-d4-03-isolated-preview.apk" "$out/aligned.apk"
+"$bt/apksigner" verify --verbose --print-certs "$out/mytodo-d4-03-isolated-preview.apk" > "$out/apk-signature.txt"

+"$bt/aapt2" dump permissions "$out/mytodo-d4-03-isolated-preview.apk" > "$out/apk-permissions.txt"

+mkdir -p "$out/test-classes" "$out/test-dex"

+find tests/d4-03-platforms/android -name '*.java' -print > "$out/test-java-sources.txt"
+javac -encoding UTF-8 -source 8 -target 8 -classpath "$android_jar:$out/classes" -d "$out/test-classes" @"$out/test-java-sources.txt"
+jar cf "$out/test-classes.jar" -C "$out/test-classes" .
+"$bt/d8" --lib "$android_jar" --classpath "$out/classes.jar" --min-api 26 --output "$out/test-dex" "$out/test-classes.jar"
+(cd "$out/test-dex"; zip -q "$out/test-unsigned.apk" classes*.dex)
+"$bt/zipalign" -p 4 "$out/test-unsigned.apk" "$out/test-aligned.apk"
+"$bt/apksigner" sign --ks "$out/isolated-test-key.jks" --ks-pass pass:android --key-pass pass:android --ks-key-alias d403preview \
+ --out "$out/mytodo-d4-03-isolated-tests.apk" "$out/test-aligned.apk"
+"$bt/apksigner" verify --verbose --print-certs "$out/mytodo-d4-03-isolated-tests.apk" > "$out/test-apk-signature.txt"
+"$bt/aapt2" dump permissions "$out/mytodo-d4-03-isolated-tests.apk" > "$out/test-apk-permissions.txt"

+(cd "$out"; sha256sum mytodo-d4-03-isolated-preview.apk mytodo-d4-03-isolated-tests.apk mytodo-d4-03-demo.html) > "$out/platform-SHA256SUMS.txt"
+printf 'Android isolated build finished; native runtime remains UNVERIFIED until instrumentation.\n'

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+[[ "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}" == true && "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA:-}" == "${GITHUB_SHA:-}" ]] || { echo 'Actions-only instrumentation' >&2; exit 1; }
+[[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" == "$GITHUB_SHA" ]] || { echo 'Checkout identity differs' >&2; exit 1; }
+build="${1:?platform build directory required}"
+out="${2:?fresh RUNNER_TEMP evidence directory required}"
+case "$out" in "$RUNNER_TEMP"/d4-native-evidence-*) ;; *) echo 'Cloud temporary evidence path required' >&2; exit 1;; esac
+[[ ! -e "$out" && -f "$build/mytodo-d4-03-isolated-preview.apk" && -f "$build/mytodo-d4-03-isolated-tests.apk" ]] || { echo 'Fresh evidence and both isolated APKs required' >&2; exit 1; }
+mkdir "$out"
+(cd "$build"; sha256sum --strict -c platform-SHA256SUMS.txt) > "$out/installed-artifact-hash-check.txt"
+serial="${ANDROID_SERIAL:?Explicit isolated Actions emulator serial required}"
+adb -s "$serial" wait-for-device
+adb -s "$serial" shell getprop > "$out/emulator-getprop.txt"
+adb -s "$serial" shell wm size > "$out/emulator-size.txt"
+adb -s "$serial" shell wm density > "$out/emulator-density.txt"
+# Reset ONLY the known synthetic preview; never touch an original app package.
+adb -s "$serial" install -r "$build/mytodo-d4-03-isolated-preview.apk" > "$out/install-preview.txt"
+adb -s "$serial" install -r "$build/mytodo-d4-03-isolated-tests.apk" > "$out/install-tests.txt"
+adb -s "$serial" shell pm clear local.gxtodo.d403preview > "$out/clear-independent-preview.txt"
+adb -s "$serial" logcat -c
+set +e
+adb -s "$serial" shell am instrument -w local.gxtodo.d403preview.tests/.PreviewInstrumentation > "$out/instrumentation.raw.log" 2>&1
+instrument_status=$?
+adb -s "$serial" logcat -d -v threadtime > "$out/emulator-logcat.raw.log" 2>&1
+adb -s "$serial" exec-out run-as local.gxtodo.d403preview tar -c -f - files/d403-evidence > "$out/native-evidence.tar" 2> "$out/evidence-extract.raw.log"
+extract_status=$?
+set -e
+if [[ "$extract_status" -ne 0 ]]; then cat "$out/evidence-extract.raw.log" >&2; echo 'Missing native report; raw logs retained' >&2; exit 1; fi
+tar -xf "$out/native-evidence.tar" -C "$out"
+printf '%s\n' "$instrument_status" > "$out/adb-instrument-exit-code.txt"
+# am instrument's exit code alone does not establish test success.
+node tests/d4-03-platforms/verify-native-report.mjs "$out/files/d403-evidence/report.json" "$out" "$build/platform-build-identity.json"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+[[ "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}" == true && "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA:-}" == "${GITHUB_SHA:-}" && "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" == "$GITHUB_SHA" ]] || { echo 'Exact Actions checkout required' >&2; exit 1; }
+out="${1:-$RUNNER_TEMP/d4-jvm-evidence-$GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
+case "$out" in "$RUNNER_TEMP"/d4-jvm-evidence-*) ;; *) echo 'Cloud temporary evidence path required' >&2; exit 1;; esac
+[[ ! -e "$out" ]] || { echo 'Fresh JVM evidence directory required' >&2; exit 1; }
+mkdir "$out"
+classes="$out/classes"
+mkdir "$classes"
+set +e
+javac -encoding UTF-8 --release 8 -d "$classes" \
+ prototypes/d4-03-platforms/android/src/local/gxtodo/replica/PomodoroClock.java \
+ tests/d4-03-platforms/jvm/PomodoroClockTest.java > "$out/javac.raw.log" 2>&1
+compile_status=$?
+test_status=125
+if [[ "$compile_status" -eq 0 ]]; then
+ java -cp "$classes" local.gxtodo.replica.PomodoroClockTest > "$out/jvm.raw.log" 2>&1
+ test_status=$?
+else
+ printf 'UNVERIFIED: JVM test not run after compiler failure\n' > "$out/jvm.raw.log"
+fi
+set -e
+cat "$out/javac.raw.log"
+cat "$out/jvm.raw.log"
+node --input-type=module - "$out" "$compile_status" "$test_status" <<'NODE'
+import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
+import path from 'node:path';
+const [out,compileRaw,testRaw]=process.argv.slice(2),compile=Number(compileRaw),test=Number(testRaw);
+const raw=await fs.readFile(path.join(out,'jvm.raw.log'),'utf8'),match=raw.match(/PomodoroClock: (\d+) assertions passed/);
+const r={sourceSha:process.env.GITHUB_SHA,runId:process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID,runAttempt:process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT,
+ evidenceKind:'Frozen pure Java deterministic timer model suite; not Android lifecycle evidence',
+ compilation:{passed:compile===0,exitCode:compile},total:compile===0?1:0,passed:compile===0&&test===0&&!!match?1:0,
+ failed:compile===0&&(test!==0||!match)?1:0,unrun:compile===0?0:1,assertionsPassed:test===0&&match?Number(match[1]):null,
+ rawLogs:['javac.raw.log','jvm.raw.log']};
+await fs.writeFile(path.join(out,'jvm-test-summary.json'),JSON.stringify(r,null,2)+'\n');
+console.log(JSON.stringify(r));
+if(compile!==0||test!==0||!match)process.exitCode=1;
+NODE
+# Kept as cloud evidence; no cleanup hides compiler/test failures.

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+[[ "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}" == true && "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA:-}" == "${GITHUB_SHA:-}" ]] || exit 1
+sdk="${ANDROID_HOME:?Hosted official SDK required}"
+export ANDROID_AVD_HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/d403-avd-$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
+mkdir "$ANDROID_AVD_HOME"
+"$sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" 'platforms;android-35' 'system-images;android-35;google_apis;x86_64' 'emulator'
+echo no | "$sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/avdmanager" create avd --name d403 --package 'system-images;android-35;google_apis;x86_64' --device pixel_5
+sudo chmod 666 /dev/kvm
+nohup "$sdk/emulator/emulator" -avd d403 -port 5554 -no-window -no-snapshot -no-audio -no-boot-anim -gpu swiftshader_indirect -memory 2048 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/d403-emulator-boot.log" 2>&1 &
+for i in $(seq 1 100); do
+ if [[ "$(adb -s emulator-5554 shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" == 1 ]]; then
+  adb -s emulator-5554 shell settings put global window_animation_scale 0
+  adb -s emulator-5554 shell settings put global transition_animation_scale 0
+  adb -s emulator-5554 shell settings put global animator_duration_scale 0
+  echo 'Official isolated API35 emulator ready'
+  exit 0
+ fi
+ sleep 3
+done
+cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/d403-emulator-boot.log"
+exit 1
